metadata.question: On August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time, did land surface temperatures in Paris exceed 32 degrees Celcius?

data.raw_code: The question asks: "On August 6, 2024 at 1:40 pm local time, did land surface temperatures in Paris exceed 32 degrees Celsius?" Key points: - Date: August 6, 2024 - Time: 1:40 pm local time (Paris is UTC+2 in summer, so 11:40 UTC) - Location: Paris, France - Measurement: Land surface temperature (LST) - Threshold: 32°C We need to: 1. Use an LST product that provides data around 11:40 UTC 2. MODIS Aqua (MYD11_L2) is suitable with its ~1:30 pm local time overpass 3. Filter for the specific time window 4. Extract LST in Celsius and check if it exceeds 32°C 5. Handle cases where no data or no valid pixels exist Plan: 1. Geometry: Paris point with buffer 2. Time: Filter Aqua collection around 11:40 UTC (e.g., 11:30-11:50) 3. If no images, try wider window, then try Terra 4. Use LST_Day_1km band with QC masking 5. Convert Kelvin to Celsius: °C = (LST * 0.02) - 273.15 6. Check maximum temperature in the area 7. Validate pixel count and temperature range ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var paris = ee.Geometry.Point(2.3522, 48.8566).buffer(1000); // 1km buffer var targetDate = '2024-08-06'; var targetTimeUTC = '11:40'; // 1:40 pm Paris time = 11:40 UTC (UTC+2) // Create time window: 30 minutes before and after target var startTime = ee.Date(targetDate + 'T' + '11:10:00'); var endTime = ee.Date(targetDate + 'T' + '12:10:00'); // 2. Data Acquisition - Try MODIS Aqua first var aquaCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11_L2') .filterBounds(paris) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); var collectionSize = aquaCollection.size().getInfo(); print('Aqua images in window:', collectionSize); // If no Aqua images, try MODIS Terra var img; var source = 'Aqua'; if (collectionSize === 0) { print('No Aqua images, trying Terra...'); var terraCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11_L2') .filterBounds(paris) .filterDate(startTime, endTime); collectionSize = terraCollection.size().getInfo(); print('Terra images in window:', collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { // Try wider window for both var widerStart = ee.Date(targetDate + 'T' + '10:00:00'); var widerEnd = ee.Date(targetDate + 'T' + '13:00:00'); aquaCollection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MYD11_L2') .filterBounds(paris) .filterDate(widerStart, widerEnd); collectionSize = aquaCollection.size().getInfo(); print('Aqua images in wider window:', collectionSize); if (collectionSize === 0) { print('No MODIS LST images found.'); print('C1'); return; } source = 'Aqua (wider)'; } else { source = 'Terra'; aquaCollection = terraCollection; } } // Get the first image img = ee.Image(aquaCollection.first()); // 3. Processing - Mask clouds using QC band var qc = img.select('QC_Day'); var mask = qc.bitwiseAnd(3).lt(2); // Bits 0-1: 00 or 01 = good or other quality var lstKelvin = img.select('LST_Day_1km').updateMask(mask); // Convert to Celsius: scale 0.02, offset -273.15 var lstCelsius = lstKelvin.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15); // 4. Calculate statistics var stats = lstCelsius.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.count(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: paris, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var maxTemp = stats.get('LST_Day_1km').getInfo(); var pixelCount = stats.get('LST_Day_1km_count').getInfo(); print('Source:', source); print('Valid pixels:', pixelCount); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (pixelCount === 0) { print('No valid LST pixels after cloud masking.'); print('C2'); return; } if (maxTemp === null || maxTemp === undefined || maxTemp > 100 || maxTemp < -100) { print('Invalid temperature value:', maxTemp); print('C3'); return; } print('Max LST (°C):', maxTemp.toFixed(2)); if (maxTemp > 32) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
